items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Cole Porter. [INTERVIEWEE] It was written for this lady and she was there too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I was so thrilled to be in that show down there, to get a chance to interview Edith Wilson. She was kind of ill then and Mona was trying to be very nice to her and take care of her. Atley Hall and that lady was in good spirits and I got to talk to them. I got to talk to her about her trip to Paris with George Gershwin and she sang a couple of songs for me that he wrote for her. I haven‟t heard any of these particular songs lately. And then this other lady that… Love For Sale, I don‟t even know who…

It was written for this lady and she was there too. It‟s amazing to find out [unintelligible] check these things out. I‟m not talking about sending somebody a ghostly whisper but I talked to Harold Aland and I talked to Will Foger.
